source_quote: "Skills are also lighter on context than `CLAUDE.md` for this kind of thing." and "A long release procedure sitting in a skill doesn't weigh on your unrelated bug fix the way it would in `CLAUDE.md`." (Claude Code best practices, 'Put team procedures in skills')
source_note: Approved by Sebi 20 Nov 2026 (PROTOCOL.md, Module 7 entry). Module 7 rules = private/m5/RULES.md 'Runs' plus private/m7/DESIGN.md 'Decisions (Sebi, 20 Nov 2026)': t2 + h2 at 9 runs each = 18 a side (`runs` is per task per side in run.py), Haiku 4.5 on every side, Claude Code 2.1.309 pinned by LAB_CLAUDE_BIN=~/.local/share/claude/versions/2.1.309, config dir ~/.claude-lab (claude.ai skill and plugin sync off), CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_NONESSENTIAL_TRAFFIC=1 on every side, standard verdict rule, three numbers before each run (pass rate, the behaviour count below, cost per passed run), the habit measured first, an agent reads every transcript, private/m7/tools/preflight.py run on the smoke and day events. allowed_tools_extra: earlier t2/h2 days added nothing because the runner's base list already covers the tasks' real commands (pnpm --filter <pkg> build/test, npx vitest, npx tsc, node); extras below exist only where the trick needs them. Design, kill switches and pilots: private/m7/DESIGN.md, RISKS.md.
behaviour_count: With side: runs where the Skill tool was called for finish-change (events). Both sides: procedure step score 0-5 per run from events and result text (build command run, test command run, built CLI run when the task names one, no test file edited, final message lists commands and results)
habit_measure: CLAUDE.md side's step score (the procedure is always in context there); historical: plain t2/h2 runs of days 1-30 that ran build and test before finishing (not yet counted)
kill_switches: With side calls the skill in fewer than 3 of 18 runs: report 'never fired', no verdict on placement
Pre-flight finds claude.ai-synced skills in the init skills list: stop and fix the config
procedure.md or either side's file changes after the day runs (sha256 below): days 67 and 68 depend on them
